description: Use when an agent needs the questions that two venues both price, with both prices and the gap between them: 'where do Polymarket and Kalshi disagree', 'compare Polymarket and Kalshi odds'. Returns up to `limit` matched questions, largest gap first, each with the venue's probability, bid, ask, volume, end date and pdata.world page on both sides. Only Polymarket and Kalshi are supported today. The pairs are matched automatically, not by hand: two events pair only when their titles hold the same words and they have the same shape (one yes/no market each, or one outcome both venues name alike); the response's `method` field spells the rule out. The match does not read the venues' resolution rules, which can differ, so a gap is a reason to read both markets, not proof of a mispricing. Pairs without a firm two-sided quote on both venues are counted in `matched` and left out of `pairs`. Human-readable version: https://pdata.world/compare/polymarket-vs-kalshi.

left.description: First venue. Supported pair: polymarket and kalshi, in either order.

limit.description: Max pairs to return, largest gap first (1-200).

page_size.description: Alias for limit. Both values must agree.

name: compare_pairs
